up: Retrieve up to 1000 activity rows with a non-null pChEMBL value for the target CHEMBL236 (Delta-type opioid receptor). Return: assay ChEMBL ID (from assays), target type (from target_dictionary), tax_id (from target_dictionary), canonical SMILES (from compound_structures), molecule ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary), standard type (from activities), and pChEMBL value (from activities). Order by molecule ChEMBL ID ascending, then assay ChEMBL ID ascending. Limit the output to 1000 rows.
sql:
SELECT
  ass.chembl_id AS "assay ChEMBL ID",
  td.target_type AS "target type",
  td.tax_id AS "tax_id",
  cs.canonical_smiles AS "canonical SMILES",
  md.chembl_id AS "molecule ChEMBL ID",
  a.standard_type AS "standard type",
  a.pchembl_value AS "pChEMBL value"
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL236'
  AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC, ass.chembl_id ASC
LIMIT 1000
